items.title: Subreddit Switcher
items.subtitle: Tap the subreddit title on a feed to search, pick a favorite, and switch right in place.

items.title: True Black Keyboard
items.subtitle: Paint the keyboard pure black for OLED screens. Find it in Interface > Display & Navigation.

items.title: Faces in Live Activities
items.subtitle: Followed threads show the newest commenter's profile picture next to their name.

items.title: Quicker Crossposts
items.subtitle: A crosspost starts with the original post's title, ready to send or clear.

items.title: Moderating Without an API Key
items.subtitle: Removal reasons, bans, flair and Moderator Mail now work on API-Key-Free accounts.
